policy.free_allowance: Exactly one complete AI item on the device plus one guided identity correction for the same item/photo set.
policy.manual_editing: Does not consume another AI item.
policy.outside_allowance: Fresh analysis, new photos, or a second item.
policy.guest_recovery: After a usable result, encrypted draft and photos remain recoverable for 24 hours unless claimed by an account.
policy.marketplaces: eBay direct; Mercari, Facebook Marketplace, and Depop assisted share/paste only.

strings.onboarding_headline: Photograph an item. Get real comps and a listing you control.
strings.onboarding_support: See what similar items actually sold for, then publish a listing you approve. No account needed to start.
strings.one_free_title: Your first item is on us
strings.one_free_support: Run one complete AI listing on this device — free, and without an account.
strings.guided_fix_body: If the AI reads the item wrong, we'll help you correct it once. A fresh analysis, new photos, or a second item is outside the free allowance.
strings.recovery_body: After you get a usable result, your encrypted guest draft and photos stay recoverable for 24 hours. Claim them with an account to keep them; otherwise they're deleted.
strings.camera_permission_title: SnapList Would Like to Access the Camera
strings.camera_permission_body: Your photos stay on this device until you choose to create a listing.
strings.camera_denied_support: Enable it in Settings, or pick a photo from your library instead — either way works.
strings.home_attention_support: Ship an order, answer a buyer, fix a listing.
strings.home_empty_headline: Photograph an item. Get real comps and a listing you control.
strings.home_empty_allowance: Your first item is on us — no account needed to try it.
